# Lenny Distilled

> PM wisdom distilled from 300+ expert interviews on Lenny's Podcast

URL: https://www.lennydistilled.com

## About

Lenny Distilled is a curated collection of product management wisdom extracted from Lenny Rachitsky's podcast interviews with industry experts. Each insight is backed by verbatim quotes from guests, allowing readers to explore the nuanced perspectives of experienced practitioners.

## Content Structure

The content is organized into six dimensions of PM craft:

- Strategy: Vision, positioning, prioritization, business models, roadmaps, policy/compliance/ethics
- Discovery: Understanding users, research, identifying problems & opportunities, psychology, UX thinking
- Execution: Shipping, iteration, process, working with eng/design, technical decisions
- Growth: Acquisition, activation, retention, monetization, metrics, experimentation
- Leadership: Influence without authority, stakeholders, teams, culture, org design
- Craft: Personal PM toolkit: decision-making, time management, senses, frameworks, career

## Navigation

- Home: https://lennydistilled.com/
- Each dimension has subthemes containing specific insights
- Each insight page shows supporting quotes with links to original video sources

## Data Format

All content is available as structured HTML with JSON-LD markup for easy parsing.
